title: mail: Mailbox object type and id scheme
description:
Define Mailbox struct in crates/mail/src/mailbox/types.rs: id (stable base32-encoded SHA-256 of group name), name (group name), parentId (null), role (null for normal groups, 'inbox' if configured), sortOrder, totalEmails, unreadEmails (0 until user-flags are wired), isSubscribed. Implement id derivation: SHA-256(group_name_bytes) → truncate to 16 bytes → base32 encode (URL-safe, no padding).

Why: the id scheme must be stable across server restarts (derived, not stored) and must satisfy JMAP id constraints (max 255 bytes, safe for use in filter arguments).

Acceptance: same group name always produces the same id; different names always produce different ids (collision test with 50 group names).
